characters.name: Brahmin
characters.description: a thin, aged Brahmin man with a bald head, weathered tanned skin, deep wrinkles, and wearing a torn worn-off-white dhoti with an old sacred thread across his bare chest

characters.name: Princess
characters.description: a young Indian princess with dark hair in an elegant braid, wearing a rich silk sari and gold jewelry, gentle eyes

scenes.narration: In a small village, a poor Brahmin survived by begging for his daily food.
One lucky day he received a pot full of flour and hung it on a hook near his bed.
Lying in bed, he dreamed of selling the flour for a high price.

dialogue.speaker: Brahmin
dialogue.line: Twenty rupees! I could sell all of it!

scenes.narration: He imagined buying two goats that would soon bear many babies.
Then he'd sell the goats and buy buffalo and cows for butter, curd and sweets to trade.
Soon he dreamed of becoming rich, with a big house and lovely gardens.
The King himself offered his daughter, the Princess, in marriage to him.
Excited in his sleep, he kicked out his leg and smashed the pot on the ground.
